context:
Built and on screen: Card Ladder (slab values, through your paid login), TCGplayer's own sold-price history, TCGCSV raw prices, and the TCGplayer export.
Idea only: PriceCharting. The slabs spec promises PSA 10 and Japanese/Chinese prices from it, but no code exists, so those fields stay blank.
Gated: eBay. DEBT72 says no eBay work without a decision entry.
home: a new decision entry, or the anchor section of the pricing-suggest spec

options.gain: Free and already in use. Removes the bias toward only cards you stocked, which the price study needs.
options.how: Download it once, check Riftbound coverage, and backfill price history.
options.label: TCGCSV daily archive
options.lose: No sold prices from other markets.

options.how: Decide API or scraping, then wire the slabs spec's promise.
options.label: PriceCharting for slabs and Japanese cards
options.lose: Paid or terms risk, both unchecked.

options.how: Strike the PriceCharting promise from the slabs spec.
options.label: Nothing new
options.lose: PSA 10 and Japanese/Chinese values stay blank.

title: Which outside price source comes next?
why: Free, already in use, and fills a measured gap.
